# Reviewer Roadtest

Reviewer Roadtest is an independent, open-source first-visit and public-evidence tester.
Its site can run a plan against a public HTTPS site. It is not a security certificate.

Read the dated report with no API key: /reports/roadtest.json
Read the separate GenLayer clarity assessment: /assessments/roadtest.json
Read a full-report GenLayer review example: /reviews/roadtest.json
Read the API schema: /openapi.json
Download a plan starter: /roadtest.template.json
Source and CI runner: https://github.com/Leokings/reviewer-roadtest

For a new target, make a plan on the website or edit the starter JSON, then POST
it to /api/run or use `npm run roadtest -- path/to/plan.json` from the repository. The runner supports
exact accessible browser roles/names and same-origin JSON/text assertions.
Hosted runs are limited to public origins and publish their reports and screenshots.
POST {network,tx_hash,expected_contract} to /api/receipt for read-only GenLayer
transaction verification. No private key is accepted by these APIs.

Interpret PASS only for the named claims and check_ids in each report. Read
not_tested and evidence_model before relying on a result. Browser screenshots
are runner observations, not on-chain proof. The ReportReview contract checks
the report hash, public HTTP assertions, screenshot bytes, and claim wording,
but cannot replay browser clicks. A wallet is needed only to request a new
on-chain assessment, not to read public reports or verify a transaction hash.
